name: MDM1EA
summary: N-Methyl-1-(3,4-methylenedioxyphenyl)-1-ethanamine (MDM1EA), also known as α,N-dimethyl-3,4-methylenedioxybenzylamine (α,N-DMMDBA) or as α,N-dimethylpiperonylamine, is an entactogen-like drug of the benzylamine family related to MDMA. It is the analogue of MDMA in which the side chain has been shortened by one carbon atom.
